root_cause.ZoneVector: GCC warns because the classes lack trivial assignment (const fields). The actual EMIT_TRIVIAL_CASE code executes byte transfer only when std::is_trivially_copyable_v<T> is true. FatalProcessOutOfMemory deliberately writes recognizable 0xde bytes into this stack diagnostic when no isolate exists, before terminating.
